sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold White Dial Pearl Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of timeless elegance to your everyday style with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a classic white dial, elegant gold-tone detailing and a beautiful pearl-accented bracelet.
The unique leaf-shaped oval dial gives the watch a distinctive vintage charm, while the delicate pearl-style detailing throughout the bracelet creates a sophisticated jewellery-inspired look. Perfect for women who love graceful accessories that make a subtle yet elegant statement.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired jewellery watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 🤍 Elegant white dial
- 🌿 Unique leaf-shaped oval dial
- 🤍 Pearl-style detailing on the bracelet
- 🔗 Stylish statement chain bracelet
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Combines the elegance of jewellery with a classic watch
- 👗 Easy to style with ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Beautiful gifting option for women
Perfect For
Everyday wear, office looks, college, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
